SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-14: FHIRPath — §6.2 Comparison. Test these items: > (Greater Than), < (Less Than), <= (Less or Equal), >= (Greater or Equal). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.evidence: Fresh FP-14 HISTORIAN probe found native/fallback divergence for Date/DateTime-vs-Time ordering. Reproducer: fhirpath('{"resourceType":"Observation"}', '@2018-01-01 < @T10:00:00') returned [] on native C++ but ['false'] on forced Python fallback. Section 6.2 defines comparison only for same-type or implicitly convertible operands and says differing types are errors; public UDF row resilience should surface this as empty/NULL.
issues.root_cause: The forced Python fallback allowed every FP_TimeBase subclass pair into comparison, so Time-only values were normalized and compared against Date/DateTime values even though Section 6.2 ordering is only defined within same-type or implicitly convertible domains.
issues.resolution: Added a fallback comparison guard that returns empty for Time-vs-Date/DateTime ordering before FP_TimeBase.compare() runs, and added native/fallback parity tests for Date/DateTime-vs-Time comparisons.
